title.narrative: Strengthening the Regional Development Bank Project

description.narrative: The project would provide long-term financing that would directly fund $50 million of subloans to micro and small enterprises outside of Colombo and be structured to provide the regulatory capital that would leverage an additional $533 million of lending.
